sentence: In the control panel settings, the dropdown under 'Choose the style for toolbar buttons:' shows the name of the currently selected style, such as Borderless.
setup: Wait until the tiddler titled '$:/ControlPanel' or 'Control Panel' is visible in the main column. In the row of tabs at the top of that tiddler, click the tab that says 'Settings'. If a second set of tabs appears inside the Settings tab and one of them says 'TiddlyWiki', click that 'TiddlyWiki' tab. Do not change any setting.
ready: The Settings tab of the control panel is selected and a list of settings is visible below the tabs.
action: Scroll down the main page to the very bottom of the settings list, until the last heading 'Toolbar Button Style', the line 'Choose the style for toolbar buttons:' and the small dropdown box with a down arrow right below that line are all fully visible. Leave the dropdown closed and unchanged. Wait 2 seconds.
broken: Directly below the line 'Choose the style for toolbar buttons:', the dropdown is a tiny, roughly square box that contains only a down arrow, and the word 'Borderless' is not written inside it.
working: Directly below the line 'Choose the style for toolbar buttons:', the dropdown is a wider box with the word 'Borderless' written inside it to the left of the down arrow.
